messages:
ashwin: Heads-up — vendor (Nexa) updated lead time for EU edge H200 shipment: 2 weeks production + possible customs reclass adding 5–9 business days. They recommend cross-dock in FRA to avoid AMS holdups. Any ops/cost/RMA implications? cc @maria @jordan

maria: Cross-dock could help but we need HS code confirmed. Last time customs flagged 8473 and stalled shipment. Can procurement confirm HS and EORI now?

procurement-bot: Quote update: EUR 1,800/unit ex-works; cross-dock handling surcharge EUR 200/unit. ETA nominal = 14 business days. Link: https://nexa.example/quote/17684 (vendor portal)

jordan: Operational note — if delay >7 days edge pool falls below SLO for eu-west-2. We can borrow 8 nodes from NA pool, but inter-region egress and replication cost ~€0.10–0.14/hr/node and latency will regress for a subset.

carla: RMA side — vendor allows consolidated RMA shipments but requires final serial manifest 24h before handover and will not accept temp IDs. Depot needs a confirmed slot. Cross-dock increases handling steps so DOA risk goes up.

liam: FYI thermal DOA for last H200 wave was ~1.9%. Vendor estimates cross-dock handling + repalletization adds ~0.25–0.4% incremental DOA risk depending on carrier. Insurance covers declared value only if declared HS matches.

ashwin: Action items: ask vendor to pre-clear HS code and push EORI + loaner ask. @maria can you escalate customs? @procurement-bot can you check if raising PO avoids surcharge?

procurement-bot: Waiver threshold for cross-dock surcharge = 50 units. Current PO = 12. No auto-waive.

maria: Escalating to customs now; scheduled call 10:30 CET with our broker. Sending Redwood EORI and tariff questionnaire. If reclassed to 8471 we might owe duty ~3.5% vs 0% — material impact on landed cost.

jordan: Short-term ops workaround: throttle some workloads, enable local batching, and shift low-priority jobs to off-peak. We can sustain degraded latency for ~72 hours before user-visible SLO breaches.

carla: For inbound RMA logistics I can prepare the serial manifest template and a printed-label flow for cross-dock. Need vendor AWB prefix and whether vendor will produce final return labels for DOA (yes/no).

vendor-rep: Hi all — Nexa here. We can provide vendor-generated return labels for DOA within 30 days. Consolidated AWB requires 3 business days lead time and we will accept only final serial manifests (no temp IDs). HS confirmed = 8471. We can expedite serial manifest processing if you upload preliminary manifest by EOD.

ashwin: Decision checklist — please react with :+1: / :-1: / :thinking: 1) Approve cross-dock surcharge (EUR 200/unit)? 2) Increase PO to 50 to waive surcharge? 3) Accept vendor return-label terms (30d DOA)? 4) Request loaners to cover capacity?

liam: :thinking: need quick landed-cost calc (duty + surcharge vs delay cost)

maria: :+1: to loaners, escalate customs now

jordan: :+1: to cross-dock to avoid unpredictable AMS hold; ops will prepare mitigation playbook

carla: :+1: manifest template ready, need AWB prefix from vendor by EOD

ashwin: I'll hold on PO change until we get loaner confirmation. If vendor sends loaner agreement we push PO to 50 to waive surcharge.

vendor-rep: Sending AWB prefix and temporary manifest endpoint now. Also can confirm loaner terms: 8 loaner units available for 30 days with return-labels covered; requires a signed LOA.

maria: Got it. LOA review queued. Will update after 10:30 CET call.

jordan: Ops note — please tag these units with `edge-fra-h200-1` on receive so we can prioritize health checks and divert DOA straight to RMA lane.

ashwin: Thanks everyone. I'll track: PO update / LOA / manifest upload / customs decision. If anything changes ping here.
